title: docs(qa): re-point seed-mode-matrix to the ignore default and url-overlay-contract to ?related=
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQ1zKyrd5HGvkrwFzZgwXAS)_

Fixes #31497
Fixes #31498

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台测试清单里两条过期条目改口：种子默认模式从 `upsert` 改为 `ignore`；记录页标签页的地址参数从 `?tab=` 改为 `?related=对象.字段`。
- 为什么改：QA 第 #31486 轮按清单原文判了两个 FAIL，但产品行为与声明一致，错的是清单（#30152 已把种子改为默认只建不改；记录页早已用 `?related=` 定位标签页）。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个 QA 清单 JSON 文件的两条目，不动产品代码、不发布任何包；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` 的 `platform-core.url-overlay-contract`（steps[3]、acceptance[1]/[2]、negative[0]、标题），再看 `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix`（steps[0]、acceptance[0]/[5]）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:platform-checklist`，预期输出 `check-platform-checklist: OK`、退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Both items live in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`; each gets a revision bump and a history row.

**`platform-core.seed-mode-matrix`, revision 7 → 8 (#31497).** PR #30152 made a seed create-only by default: an omitted `mode` is `ignore`.

- steps[0]: `defaultMode` defaults to 'ignore', not 'upsert'. It also gains the QA run's note that an unprefixed draft fails the whole publish-drafts batch (outcome 'refused', publishedCount 0), because steps[0] already drives that publish.
- acceptance[0]: upsert is named as declared explicitly, with ignore named as the default.
- acceptance[5]: the seam reads `dataset.mode || config.defaultMode ('ignore')`.
- Accepted extension in the same item (seat's answer before the claim): variants[2] drops "(the default)" from upsert, and source[2] reads "defaultMode is SeedSchema.shape.mode, default 'ignore'". Left alone, both would contradict the clauses.
- Not added: the runner's note that `POST /packages/ID/discard-drafts` removes a draft-only item. No step deletes a draft item, so the item never reaches that path.

Every probe step names its mode, so no verdict moves.

**`platform-core.url-overlay-contract`, revision 4 → 5 (#31498).** The record page addresses its tabs with `?related=OBJECT.FIELD` (`RECORD_RELATED_ENLARGE_PARAM` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/urlParams.ts`; `openEnlargedRelated` / `closeEnlargedRelated` in `RecordDetailView.tsx`). Leaving Overview pushes one entry, moving between tabs replaces it, and Back, Esc or Overview go back to the record in one step.

- steps[3]: on a showcase account record, append `?related=showcase_contact.account` (a cold load lands on that tab), switch tabs several times and press Back once. You return to the record's Overview in one step and never step back through tab selections.
- acceptance[1]: tab switches add at most one entry (the first leave of Overview), and palette and shortcuts add none. Its verify step reads the record's Overview as the post-Back location.
- acceptance[2]: `?related=OBJECT.FIELD` cold-loads the tab.
- negative[0]: the same change, for the tab half.
- Accepted extension in the same item: the title says record tabs push one entry and then replace, and "?related cold-loads a record tab".

## Verification

Facts re-read on `origin/main` `4894cfe1` before editing:

- `seed.zod.ts` L207 `mode: SeedMode.default('ignore')`.
- `seed-loader.zod.ts` L253 `defaultMode: SeedSchema.shape.mode`.
- `metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` L1303 `const mode = dataset.mode || config.defaultMode;`.
- `protocol.ts` publishPackageDrafts pre-flight: the whole batch is refused with `publishedCount: 0`.
- `RecordDetailView.tsx` L843–872 and `urlParams.ts` L105.

16 derived gates ran on head `d5d9482c`, all exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciled them: 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. After merging `main` (head `bb608509`, which makes no change to this file), `pnpm check:platform-checklist` re-ran with exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: a QA ledger under `docs/`, so nothing publishes.
- `?tab=` (`RECORD_DETAIL_TAB_PARAM`) is still read in `RecordDetailView.tsx` and handed to `withPageTabsUrlSync` for a record page that declares its own tabs component. The card's "not read on a columns record page" is accurate as scoped. This item drives the columns page's tab row, so it no longer names `?tab=`.
